conclusions.run: Registers a new scan and calls codex.startThread; no saved-session recovery input.
conclusions.workflowId: Reuses a saved completed scan; an interrupted scan is started again.
conclusions.parentScanId: Creates an independent child scan and scan ID; not checkpoint continuation.
conclusions.deepCoordinator: Plugin-internal expired coordinator recovery is not a CodexSecurity SDK resume API.
conclusions.applicationRecovery: Only a verified Axiom result.commit.json can restore an unarchived result without model calls.
